description: This file implements a drag-and-drop tree structure with methods for node manipulation, event handling, and UI updates, including support for expanding/collapsing nodes and context menus.

classes.name: JSDragDropTree
classes.description: A class providing drag-and-drop tree functionality with node management, event handling, and UI updates.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds an event listener to an HTML element.

methods.name: removeEvent
methods.description: Removes an event listener from an HTML element.

methods.name: Get_Cookie
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie value by name.

methods.name: Set_Cookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie with specified parameters.

methods.name: setFileNameRename
methods.description: Sets the URL for renaming items.

methods.name: setFileNameDelete
methods.description: Sets the URL for deleting items.

methods.name: setRenameAllowed
methods.description: Enables or disables renaming of nodes.

methods.name: setDeleteAllowed
methods.description: Enables or disables deletion of nodes.

methods.name: setMaximumDepth
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed depth for nodes.

methods.name: setMessageMaximumDepthReached
methods.description: Sets the message displayed when maximum depth is reached.

methods.name: setImageFolder
methods.description: Sets the folder path for node images.

methods.name: setFolderImage
methods.description: Sets the image for folder nodes.

methods.name: setPlusImage
methods.description: Sets the image for expand icon.

methods.name: setMinusImage
methods.description: Sets the image for collapse icon.

methods.name: setLeafImage
methods.description: Sets the image for leaf nodes.

methods.name: setTreeId
methods.description: Assigns an ID to the tree.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Expands all nodes in the tree.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Collapses all nodes in the tree.

methods.name: getTopPos
methods.description: Calculates the top position of a node.

methods.name: getLeftPos
methods.description: Calculates the left position of a node.

methods.name: showHideNode
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a node's children.

methods.name: initDrag
methods.description: Initializes drag operation for a node.

methods.name: timerDrag
methods.description: Handles the delay before starting drag.

methods.name: moveDragableNodes
methods.description: Updates position of the dragged node.

methods.name: dropDragableNodes
methods.description: Handles dropping of a node.

methods.name: createDropIndicator
methods.description: Creates visual indicator for drop position.

methods.name: dragDropCountLevels
methods.description: Counts levels up or down in the tree for drag validation.

methods.name: cancelEvent
methods.description: Cancels default event behavior.

methods.name: cancelSelectionEvent
methods.description: Prevents text selection during drag.

methods.name: getNodeOrders
methods.description: Serializes node order and hierarchy.

methods.name: highlightItem
methods.description: Highlights a node for context menu actions.

methods.name: removeHighlight
methods.description: Removes highlight from a node.

methods.name: hasSubNodes
methods.description: Checks if a node has children.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a node after confirmation.

methods.name: __refreshDisplay
methods.description: Updates node display after changes.

methods.name: __deleteItem_step2
methods.description: Performs server-side deletion via AJAX.

methods.name: __deleteComplete
methods.description: Handles server response for delete.

methods.name: __renameComplete
methods.description: Handles server response for rename.

methods.name: __saveTextBoxChanges
methods.description: Saves renamed node text and updates server.

methods.name: __cancelRename
methods.description: Cancels renaming process.

methods.name: __renameCheckKeyCode
methods.description: Handles key events during renaming.

methods.name: __createTextBox
methods.description: Creates input box for renaming.

methods.name: __renameEnableTextBox
methods.description: Enables editing of node text.

methods.name: renameItem
methods.description: Initiates renaming of a node.

methods.name: initTree
methods.description: Initializes the tree structure, event handlers, and context menus.
